fields.Name: T076 - Create New Saved View Round-Trip
fields.Description: Exercises the view CREATE + server-persist path (quick-save dialog / config-panel Settings tab -> OnSaveAsNew), a write round-trip distinct from read-only view selection and from record CRUD.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open the saved-view selector (layer-group icon) and click 'New View' in the panel footer (this opens a quick-save / configure dialog). Enter a unique view name such as 'CU Grid Test 4821' and confirm creation (Create View / Save). Success is the new view being created and becoming the active view — its name shows on the selector button and/or appears under 'My Views'. You do NOT need to configure columns or filters; naming and saving is enough.

judgeValidationCriteria: A create/quick-save dialog appears with an editable view-name field after clicking 'New View'
After saving, the newly named view becomes the selected view (name shown on selector button) or appears in the 'My Views' list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
